Same model. Same question. One fails, one gets it right 🤯

Real run on my laptop: qwen2.5 3B via Ollama.
❌ bare model: can't look at the folder, hands me a script instead
✅ same model + a tiny harness (a loop, 1 rule, 1 tool): "7 files, biggest is db.log"

Nothing about the model changed. Only the harness.

Part 2/6 of Agent Harness 101. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
